core_meaning.primary_meaning: Gulsum is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Kulthum (Turkish form)”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Gulsum corresponds to the Arabic form كُلْثُوم (Arabic root ك ل ث م (k-l-th-m); كُلْثُوم (Kulthūm)). Its core sense is gulsum; kulthum (turkish form). Gulsum is the Turkish form of Arabic كُلْثُوم (Kulthūm), a feminine name borne by members of the Prophet's family.

persian.name: کلثوم
